recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow metadata correction to the applied FHIR-49782 implementation; broader RelatedArtifact policy or executable resolve() constraints should require renewed work-group review.
issue_request: FHIR-49782 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. The original request proposed replacing relatedArtifact on Library, ActivityDefinition, and PlanDefinition, but the final CDS decision kept RelatedArtifact and required resource-specific constraints and guidance for Library, ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, and RequestOrchestration.
initial_application: Commit 786db24816fa015ad5f9c0aad50073b686fd8cee added the RelatedArtifact constraints to the CDS resources. Commit 76f561c2361f1ced872d4a1a5a0df756e2fa1471 then removed successor/predecessor resolve() constraints and converted them to narrative conformance guidance after PR review discussion. PR HL7/fhir#3916 merged the applied changes in 3cd78c385040041f240053d8481b7ff4797c635b. The remaining defect was that RequestOrchestration rqg-2 had a copied source canonical of PlanDefinition.
additional_context: FHIR-50010 is the broader Applied/Persuasive RelatedArtifact simplification and usage-guidance issue. Zulip discussion identified FHIR-49782 as the CDS follow-up tracker, with separate CQI and terminology follow-ups. The PR review thread explains why resolve() target-type checks should remain narrative guidance rather than executable constraints.
reconciliation: Changed only source/requestorchestration/structuredefinition-RequestOrchestration.xml so rqg-2's source value is http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/RequestOrchestration. The constraint expression, warning severity, and surrounding conformance behavior were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/requestorchestration/structuredefinition-RequestOrchestration.xml: corrected rqg-2 constraint source canonical from PlanDefinition to RequestOrchestration.
